ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulumul Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Qur’an.
   C. Say Ulumul Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)

   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
